# Municipalities

This folder catalogs Danish municipalities evaluated in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Atrial Fibrillation Database in Denmark (AFDK). Each page details a specific municipality's clinical quality performance, focusing heavily on compliance with safety practices for Direct Oral Anticoagulants (DOACs) under Indicator 4b, as well as metrics for early anticoagulation initiation and ischemic stroke prevention. The data highlights the decentralized nature of Denmark's healthcare system, benchmarking local quality development across both large urban centers and smaller rural communities.

## Pages

- [[broenderslev-dronninglund|Brønderslev-Dronninglund]] — Achieved the highest recorded compliance rate (97.7%) for DOAC safety practices among all municipalities in the report.
- [[fanoe|Fanø]] — Recorded an exceptional 99.1% compliance rate for DOAC safety monitoring, though it struggled with low patient volumes on secondary indicators.
- [[fredericia|Fredericia]] — Met the national standard for DOAC safety practices with a 95.4% compliance rate and is tracked for early anticoagulation initiation.
- [[frederikshavn|Frederikshavn]] — Performed exceptionally well on DOAC safety monitoring (97.7% compliance) and consistently met standards for stroke prevention metrics.
- [[haderslev|Haderslev]] — Achieved a 95.9% compliance rate for DOAC safety practices, placing it among the highest-performing municipalities evaluated.
- [[hjoerring|Hjørring]] — Exceeded the national threshold for DOAC safety monitoring with a 96.1% compliance rate and is tracked for early treatment initiation.
- [[holstebro|Holstebro]] — Precisely met the 95.0% national threshold for DOAC safety practices and recorded positive metrics for stroke prevention.
- [[ikast-brande|Ikast-Brande]] — Successfully met the national standard for DOAC safety monitoring with a 95.4% compliance rate across its eligible patient cohort.
- [[kolding|Kolding]] — Recorded one of the highest compliance proportions for DOAC safety practices at 95.8% and met standards for early anticoagulation.
- [[langeland|Langeland]] — A smaller municipality that reached full standard fulfillment for DOAC safety practices with a 95.4% compliance rate.
- [[odense|Odense]] — Represented the highest proportion among larger municipalities for DOAC safety compliance at 96.3%.
- [[silkeborg|Silkeborg]] — Ranked among the highest values for DOAC safety practices with a 96.3% compliance rate and detailed stroke prevention metrics.
- [[skanderborg|Skanderborg]] — Achieved a 96.0% compliance rate for DOAC safety monitoring, ranking among the highest in the national report.
- [[skive|Skive]] — Demonstrated strong clinical performance by exceeding the national standard for DOAC safety practices with a 95.3% compliance rate.
- [[struer|Struer]] — Met and exceeded the national standard for DOAC safety monitoring with a 95.4% compliance rate.
- [[thisted|Thisted]] — Exactly met the 95.0% national standard threshold for DOAC safety practices and is tracked for early anticoagulation initiation.
